comment: Krypton's list price for the pack, before the supply discount. unit_price is this less discount_pct, and is what we actually pay.
A build-up line: shows the product, its rate and its cost so the margin can be seen, but its amount is not part of the section price and it prints as specification text on the client copy.

How the final price was set: spread (rates scaled to hit the target) or discount (rates kept, a visible discount line brings the total down). Null means the total is simply whatever the rates add up to.
The total Charles said he wanted, kept so that reopening the quotation shows what was aimed at even after the rates were rewritten.
